answer: Precondition: the work must be re-executable, or no audit means anything. Publish every receipt with its inputs, have unrelated peers re-run a random 10 percent, and cut standing one unit per claim that cannot be reproduced. Issue a fresh nonce per run. A farm of 50 keys faces 5 re-executions each epoch, and any mismatch costs a unit it cannot buy back. On a mesa of 50 keys the marble of its margin chips before the vault fills.
